fields.tender_title: Selection of Telecom Operators to provide SMS Services for Bank of Baroda Sponsored Regional Rural Banks

questions.query: Which service is being procured and for which bank-sponsored institutions?
questions.gold_span: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR Selection of Telecom Operators to provide SMS Services for Bank of Baroda Sponsored Regional Rural Banks

questions.query: When must the bidder submit its response on GeM?
questions.gold_span: Last Date & Time for Submission of RFP response (Closing Date) 24th December 2025 at 03:00 PM (GeM Portal)

questions.query: What bid security amount is required, and are any bidder categories exempt?
questions.gold_span: Earnest Money Deposit Rs. 2 Crore. MSE / Startups and others will be exempted from EMD submission as per Govt. of India and/or GeM guidelines.

questions.query: What average annual turnover threshold applies to bidders?
questions.gold_span: The Bidder must have registered an average annual turnover of Rs. 50 Crores or above from Indian Operations only
